snippet.title: Jupiter Junkworks Gameplay Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Fast, strategic, and satisfyingly crunchy—Jupiter Junkworks brings classic arcade puzzle vibes
with a fresh sci-fi twist. Complete contracts to earn resources and unlock upgrades in both
gameplay and story. This brand new trailer with developer commentary from Pixel Drake was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913540
